classification_signals: Dissertation for the degree of Doctor of Liberal Arts (DLA) in Architecture (page 1)
Includes theoretical research and practical application (page 3)
Aims to apply theoretical knowledge of environmental psychology to solve practical problems in urban construction in China, focusing on practical application (page 4)
Describes specific design projects and their implementation (Chapter 5, pages 45-117)
Utilizes mixed methods: site experiments, behavioral observation, questionnaire method, projection technology, and statistical methods for data analysis (page 11)
Presents environmental evaluation results using multi-point scales for various projects (e.g., Tables 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 13)
title: APPLIED RESEARCH ON ENVIRONMENTAL PSYCHOLOGY IN ARCHITECTURE ENVIRONMENT DESIGN

findings.antecedent: Traditional Feng Shui thought (harmonious coexistence between people and environment)
findings.consequent: Site selection for residential bases
findings.source: page 55, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, A. Site construction
findings.quote: The site selection of Hougou New Village is combined with the requirements of Chinese people for the site selection of residential bases, reflecting the traditional feng shui thought, which emphasizes the harmonious coexistence between people and the environment, which is consistent with the insight of environmental psychology.

findings.antecedent: Terrain planning in the shape of a treasure bowl (bionic morphological design)
findings.consequent: Symbolic meaning of architectural environment, cultural connotation of the site, artistic expression of architectural environment
findings.source: page 55, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, A. Site construction
findings.quote: The terrain planning of the whole village is in the shape of a treasure bowl, which symbolizes auspiciousness in Chinese culture and reflects the symbolic meaning of the architectural environment, the cultural connotation of the site, and the artistic expression of the architectural environment.

findings.antecedent: Environmentally friendly design (low-carbon design approach, reverence for nature)
findings.consequent: Environmental atmosphere construction
findings.source: page 57, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: The author believes that environmentally friendly design is a low-carbon design approach, an attitude of architects, and a kind of reverence for nature.

findings.antecedent: Vivid color design
findings.consequent: Artistic sense of the environment, meaning of the site
findings.source: page 58, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: The vivid color design greatly enhances the artistic sense of the environment and the meaning of the site.

findings.antecedent: Exterior wall material (texture coating)
findings.consequent: Decorative effect, insulation effect, environmental image (unified style, clean, tidy)
findings.source: page 58, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: The exterior wall material of the building adopts the texture coating as the main wall decoration, which has a nice decorative effect and insulation effect and reflects the environmental image of unified style and clean and tidy.

findings.antecedent: Villagers' participation in courtyard design
findings.consequent: Diversified and personalized environment, sense of home
findings.source: page 58, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: the author left the design of the courtyard of each unit to the villagers and let them participate in the construction of their homes, to form a more diversified and personalized environment and make their homes have a variety of possibilities.

findings.antecedent: Site nodes, information billboards, public parking lot
findings.consequent: Orderly connection of sections, prominent environmental atmosphere, clear spatial image
findings.source: page 58, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: The information billboards are also added near the public parking lot. Through the design of site nodes, the connection of each section is more orderly, and the atmosphere of the whole environment is more prominent, creating a clear spatial image.

findings.antecedent: Clustered living environment (tight layout, scientific regional division, smooth traffic flow, three-fork road network, personal space ensured)
findings.consequent: Villagers' gathering, exchanges, activities, territoriality, good sense of experience, maintenance and construction of living environment
findings.source: page 59, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, C. Design of man-land relationship
findings.quote: Its purpose is to create a kind of clustered living environment so that villagers can gather and have more exchanges and activities. However, density does not mean crowding. Scientific regional division and smooth traffic flow lines can be well connected to each region. On the premise of ensuring personal space, the three-fork road network design makes villagers' activities on the site more convenient and enhances their territoriality. It causes villagers and their living environment to form a harmonious interactive relationship. A beautiful living environment brings villagers a good sense of experience, and villagers also pay more attention to the maintenance and construction of the living environment.

findings.antecedent: Themed sculpture installation and information board at community entrance
findings.consequent: Social cohesion, conveyance of party/government information, opportunities for villagers/cadres to meet, equal information exchange, landmark image
findings.source: page 60, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, C. Design of man-land relationship
findings.quote: A themed sculpture installation and information board were designed at the community entrance in collaboration with the local government and the village committee. It reflects forceful social cohesion and can well convey the latest party and government information. At the same time, it can increase the opportunity for villagers and village committee cadres to meet, which is conducive to the equal information exchange between managers and villagers. At the same time, it is conducive to the formation of landmark images to show the image of Hougou New Village to the society.

findings.antecedent: Central public square (connected by three-fork road)
findings.consequent: Daily leisure, fitness, social interaction frequency, children's play environment, healthy living habits, shared community living room for visitors
findings.source: page 60, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, C. Design of man-land relationship
findings.quote: The central public square is a representative section in the planning of Hougou New village, which is in the center of the community. It is connected to each area by a three-fork road. People can easily reach wherever they want to go, with a definite way of finding their way. It provides villagers with a place for daily leisure and fitness, which makes up for the regret of living in the ancient village. The favorable site atmosphere increases the frequency of villagers' daily social interaction, on the one hand, provides an environment for children to play, and on the other hand, helps villagers form healthy living habits. The existence of the central square also offers a shared community living room for visitors to Hougou New Village.

findings.antecedent: Daycare center for the elderly (close to scenic spots, natural environment, rational function design)
findings.consequent: Comfortable environment for elderly, response to aging problem, improved attention to elderly, social significance
findings.source: page 62, Part I. Hougou New Village Comprehensive Project, C. Design of man-land relationship
findings.quote: The design of the daycare center for the elderly provides a more comfortable environment for the elderly group. It mainly offers basic daycare and entertainment services for the elderly in the new countryside. Its location in the Longmen river, close to the Gushan scenic spots, the geographical condition is superior, the beautiful natural environment, rational construction function design for elders provide a modern experience. It responds well to the aging problem of the community, improves people's attention to the elderly group, and endows the site with more social significance.

findings.antecedent: Architectural shape derived from mountainous form (artistic treatment)
findings.consequent: Harmonious 'picture and bottom' relationship between architecture and environment

findings.antecedent: Design technique ('pictographic' design, deconstruction of Chinese character '山')
findings.consequent: Positive architectural image (striving and enterprising spirit), clear visual focus, adaptive symbiosis between building and environment, emotional/cultural connotation
findings.source: page 65, Part II. Chinese folk Cultural Heritage Rescue Project memorial Hall, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: the author deconstructs the image of the Chinese character "山" and creates a positive architectural image through design techniques, reflecting the spirit of striving and enterprising. Through the construction of the clear architectural form, it accurately constructs the visual focus of the site, realizes the adaptive symbiosis between the building and the surrounding environment, and conveys the emotional and cultural connotation of the site to people.

findings.antecedent: Building materials (blue slate, gray tile, cypress wood, recycled abandoned materials)
findings.consequent: Local atmosphere, temperature, eco-friendly construction process, inheritance of traditional local culture
findings.source: page 65, Part II. Chinese folk Cultural Heritage Rescue Project memorial Hall, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: the author chooses materials consistent with the traditional architecture of the ancient village, mainly blue slate, gray tile, cypress wood, and others. In addition, the author recycled some abandoned building materials from Hougou village and processed them for the curtain walls' decoration. The use of decorative materials reflects the principle of "locality" in the design. Materials rich in local texture give the building a local atmosphere and temperature. The author uses the low-carbon construction method to ingeniously add the genes of the ancient village to the new building and strengthen the social image of the project.

findings.consequent: Heat insulation, heat preservation, good light transmittance

findings.quote: in the design of the curtain wall of the building, the author uses a large area of insulating glass curtain wall as the main decoration of the building facade, which plays a good role in heat insulation and heat preservation, which has a good light transmittance.

findings.antecedent: Air vents on gable walls (decorated with traditional round brick artistic components)
findings.consequent: Quality of air circulation inside building, reduced energy consumption
findings.source: page 66, Part II. Chinese folk Cultural Heritage Rescue Project memorial Hall, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: the author draws on the treatment of ancient buildings and designs air vents on both sides of the gable wall, which are decorated with traditional round brick artistic components. The design approach of low carbon and low technology improves the quality of air circulation inside the building and reduces the energy consumption of the building as much as possible.

findings.quote: the author plans an ecological parking lot on the east side of the memorial hall. On the one hand, it provides flexible parking space for temporary large-scale activities. On the other hand, it alleviates the influence of dust weather on this area to a certain extent and plays a fantastic greening effect.

Especially in the mature season of jujube trees, children like to play here, which forms a positive interaction between people and the environment and lets the cold building in the surroundings more warmth.

findings.consequent: Pleasant landscape, quiet and exclusive garden for hotel tourists

findings.quote: The design team plans an ecological riverside garden on the bank opposite the hotel, relying on the landform of surrounding mountains and the natural water body of Longmen River to create a pleasant landscape. The two sides are connected by a specially designed chain bridge, creating a quiet and exclusive garden for the tourists staying in the hotel.

findings.antecedent: Retained wild small white pear trees, original ecological sightseeing bus riding area
findings.consequent: Tourists enjoying natural scenery, shortened cognitive distance, interactive relationship between tourists and environment, immersive experience, ecological image of local agricultural products, mutually beneficial human-land relationship
findings.source: page 75, Part III. Comprehensive project of Tourist Reception Center of Hougou Ancient Village Scenic Spot, C. Design of man-land relationship
findings.quote: the author retained a group of wild small white pear trees located in the southeast of the tourist reception center and designed an original ecological sightseeing bus riding area based on the characteristics of the original site and the needs of tourists. Tourists can enjoy the natural scenery along the riverfront while walking in groups to the ancient village ticket area or directly take sightseeing electric vehicles. ... The low-carbon design approach shortens tourists' cognitive distance to the environment and emphasizes the interactive relationship between tourists and the environment. The immersive experience enables visitors to feel the natural charm of the Hougou ancient village and sets up the ecological image of local agricultural products, forming a mutually beneficial human-land relationship.

findings.antecedent: Tourist reception center design (sloping roof, verandah function, continuous rest areas, semi-open outdoor smoking area)
findings.consequent: Information sharing, face-to-face communication, reasonable tourist service path, civilized image of scenic spot, humanistic care
findings.source: page 75-76, Part III. Comprehensive project of Tourist Reception Center of Hougou Ancient Village Scenic Spot, C. Design of man-land relationship
findings.quote: the author pays special attention to the shared space section, hoping to promote information sharing and face-to-face communication between visitors through flexible space organization. First of all, the main body of the building is a sloping roof form with the verandah function, which connects the fast-food restaurant, police room, bathroom, maternal and child room, medical clinic, and other areas, and through the form of the verandah to build a reasonable tourist service path. Secondly, the author designed continuous rest areas in the verandah area and used reasonable distance control to increase the opportunity for visitors to have face-to-face communication. In addition, a semi-open outdoor space is designed in the middle of the building complex to provide tourists with an exclusive outdoor smoking area, creating a civilized image of the scenic spot and giving the solemn Chinese-style buildings humanistic care.

findings.antecedent: Kindergarten entrance building architectural design (rocket launch tower inspiration, geometric analysis, graphic decoding, metal device with symbolic significance)
findings.consequent: Optimized original architectural image, new environmental visualization image, reinforced properties, timeliness, safety of building, child-friendly environment, positive symbolic meaning (positive, climbing mountains, mother's warm embrace, time travel, exploration desire)
findings.source: page 98, Part I. Kindergarten entrance architectural design project, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: Inspired by the rocket launch tower, the design transforms children's love of aerospace technology into the architectural design language. ... the author redesigned a metal device with symbolic significance to combine with it, which well optimized the original architectural image, formed a new environmental visualization image, and reinforced the properties, timeliness, and safety of the building. It's like giving a boy the mechanical suit of his dreams. It's inspiring. ... The shape of the rocket based on the main building frame conveys a positive symbolic meaning, which shows the implied symbol of being positive and climbing mountains. The ring shape in the buffer zone is intimate, symbolizing the mother's warm embrace, matching with warm colors to give children a sense of intimacy and security. In addition, the shape of the ring combined with the rocket also symbolizes the meaning of time travel, increasing the interest in the entrance area and catering to children's desire to explore.

findings.antecedent: Color design (white, yellow, coffee, purple as decorative colors; bright red, white, dark blue, dark gray as primary/secondary colors)
findings.consequent: Inspiration for imagination, arousal of individual emotional response, pro-nature color system, vivid/clear activity path, positive space image, joyful feeling, childlike/dreamy site atmosphere
findings.source: page 98-99, Part I. Kindergarten entrance architectural design project, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: The color of architecture plays an irreplaceable role in inspiring imagination. According to the characteristics of kids’ perception, the author chose white, yellow, coffee, and purple as decorative colors. These hues play different personality characteristics, which could arouse an individual emotional response. ... In the decorative design of the building facade, the author chose bright red and white as the primary decorative colors of the entrance area, dark blue as the decoration of the graffiti wall, and dark gray as the decoration of the ground, creating a pro-nature color system. Red, white, and blue represent the blue sky, white clouds, and the sun; solid wood colors and dark grays represent forests and rocks. The natural color collocation forms a space-time echo with the color of the entrance building of the kindergarten, constructing a vivid and clear activity path and a positive space image. ... Bright color collocation and vivid light and shadow changes bring children a very joyful feeling in vision, touch, and psychology, forming a childlike and dreamy site atmosphere.

findings.antecedent: Colored latticed glass and white perforated aluminum plate (building curtain wall decoration)
findings.consequent: Joyful feeling (vision, touch, psychology), childlike/dreamy site atmosphere
findings.source: page 109, Part I. Kindergarten entrance architectural design project, B. The creation of atmosphere
findings.quote: the author skillfully uses colored latticed glass and white perforated aluminum plate as the building curtain wall's decoration. Bright color collocation and vivid light and shadow changes bring children a very joyful feeling in vision, touch, and psychology, forming a childlike and dreamy site atmosphere.

findings.antecedent: Ring device in entrance buffer zone (obstacle design, three-gradient red ring shapes)
findings.consequent: Safe passage environment, children slowing down, safe path, vivid spatial pattern, highly elastic environment combination, venue for grand celebrations, spiritual fortress for kindergarten
findings.source: page 111, Part I. Kindergarten entrance architectural design project, C. Design of man-land relationship
findings.quote: to create a safe passage environment, the author specially designed a ring device in the entrance buffer zone to build a passive spatial form in the form of obstacle design so that the children who are about to enter the area can slow down and construct a safe path. At the same time, the three-gradient red ring shapes create a vivid spatial pattern, which together with the bionic form of the rocket constitutes a highly elastic environment combination. Such spatial organization constructs a high-quality architectural image that virtually provides the kindergarten with a venue for holding grand celebrations and builds a spiritual fortress for the kindergarten.

findings.antecedent: Semi-open form of building (transitional area, flexible site environment, physical buffer zone)
findings.consequent: Psychological adaptation area for children, breaking traditional entry, immersive space atmosphere, reduced negative feelings about enclosed spaces
findings.source: page 112, Part I. Kindergarten entrance architectural design project, C. Design of man-land relationship
findings.quote: Secondly, the semi-open form of the building provides a transitional area, resulting in a very flexible site environment. Based on analyzing the phenomenon of children's stress response, we innovatively established a physical buffer zone in the entrance area of the teaching building, creating a psychological adaptation area for children, breaking the traditional way of entering the entrance area of the kindergarten building, and creating an immersive space atmosphere, reduce young children's negative feelings about enclosed spaces.

findings.antecedent: Outdoor activity areas and sharing areas (blue background wall for doodling, preservative wood platform for climbing, red low wall for hiding games)
findings.consequent: Children expressing ideas, climbing freely, sharing games, play environment

limitations: Some villagers in Hougou New Village were not satisfied with the new environment due to a lack of space for raising large livestock, reflecting adaptability problems in the transition from old to new environments (page 63).

The interior of the Chinese folk Cultural Heritage Rescue Project Memorial Hall was still under construction and not fully open to the public, leading to a 'General' rating in post-use evaluation (page 69).
Tourists' evaluation of the visual design of scenic spots in the Tourist Reception Center declined, indicating a need to strengthen aesthetics and identification, such as road signs (page 77).
The planning of supporting facilities for new energy vehicles (e.g., charging system, exclusive parking area) was not fully considered in the Tourist Reception Center project (page 77).

The shared landscape designed in the periphery of the kindergarten park entrance could not be fully realized due to occupying part of the urban road system, affecting functional evaluation (page 105).

Heavy rain caused poor drainage and water stains on the aluminum plate surface of the kindergarten entrance building, and decorative components fell off due to early structural design defects, increasing maintenance workload (page 105).
Children sometimes dug at the carved aluminum plate of the kindergarten entrance building, posing security risks (page 116).
minimum_safe_summary: This dissertation presents applied research on environmental psychology in architectural design, focusing on creating ideal living environments that foster harmonious human-land relationships. Through theoretical exploration and practical application in several case studies (e.g., Hougou Ancient Village planning, Memorial Hall, Tourist Reception Center, and a Kindergarten renovation), the author demonstrates how insights from environmental psychology can guide design decisions to enhance user experience, social interaction, and overall well-being. Key findings highlight the positive impact of culturally sensitive, eco-friendly, and child-centric designs on aesthetic appreciation, functionality, emotional connection, and man-land relationships, as evidenced by 'Excellent' and 'Good' ratings in environmental evaluations. Limitations include challenges in balancing modern needs with traditional lifestyles, incomplete project phases affecting evaluation, and practical issues like material durability and integration with urban infrastructure.

theory_commitments.specific_claim: Principles of environmental psychology are fundamental to understanding and designing architectural environments.
The concept of harmonious coexistence between people and environment, as embodied in Feng Shui, should guide architectural site selection and design.
